title: dLocal Limited Unaudited Consolidated Condensed Interim Financial Statements at March 31, 2026
excerpt: Weighted average common shares for diluted earnings per share were 298,454,336.
summary: The Q1 2026 interim statements report USD 815.6 million cash and equivalents, USD 553.3 million total equity, USD 41.9 million attributable profit, diluted weighted-average shares of 298.5 million including employee-plan dilution, USD 645.1 million net trade receivables, and USD 1.116 billion trade and other payables. The statements identify working-capital settlement balances and employee share plans relevant to net-cash and dilution normalization.
